name: Electric body groomer

lead: An electric body groomer is a trimmer with a guard system and protective blade head made for chest, abdomen, back and groin hair. It shortens hair rather than removing it.
It is used for tidy trimming that leaves a natural look. No dedicated clinical studies were found, and reviews of hair removal practices list trimming as a lower-risk option.

paras: Oscillating blades behind a skin-protecting guard cut hair at a set length with little contact with skin.
Risks are minor nicks, pulling, irritation and ingrown hairs if trimmed very short. Hygiene and blade care are described as important, particularly for the groin. The effect lasts days.
